_meta.description: One-off snapshot of FantasyPros ECR/ADP data for 2026 drafted players, fetched via the FantasyPros v2 API (scripts/fantasypros_credentials.json) on 2026-08-08. NOT auto-refreshed by fetch_espn_draft.py - that script just loads this file. See fetch_espn_draft.py's fetch_fantasypros_data() docstring for the full story: FantasyPros' free API tier caps bulk requests (consensus-rankings, players-list) at 10 results regardless of filters, and rate-limits individual single-player lookups hard after ~20 calls in a session. RB/WR entries (132/132, 100% coverage) use position_ecr_rank/position_ecr_pool_size (POSITIONAL ECR rank, from a brief window before the key's access degraded to the free-tier cap). QB/TE entries (22/36, partial) use overall_ecr_rank/overall_adp_rank (OVERALL rank, from single-player lookups via /nfl/players?player=ID, which isn't subject to the bulk cap - player IDs resolved by scraping each player's public FantasyPros page for their embedded player-id, no API key needed for that step). 14 of 168 drafted skill players have no entry at all and fall back to a neutral value in grading.
